news.title: ESCORTS: New Greenfield Capacity And Higher Dividend Will Support Future Re Rating
news.body: Analysts have trimmed their fair value estimate for Escorts Kubota from ₹4,509.53 to ₹4,234.89 as they factor in updated assumptions around revenue growth, profit margins, the discount rate and future P/E expectations. What's in the News Recommended final dividend of 330% for FY2026, equal to ₹33.0 per share, taking the total FY2026 payout to ₹51.0 per share including a special dividend of ₹18.0 per share, described as 82.1% higher than the previous year (company announcement).

news.title: Full year 2026 earnings: EPS and revenues exceed analyst expectations
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹124 (up from ₹102 in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹121.1b (up 18% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹13.7b (up 22% from FY 2025). Profit margin: 11% (in line with FY 2025). Revenue exceeded analyst estimates by 6.1%. Earnings per share (EPS) also surpassed analyst estimates by 85%. Revenue is forecast to grow 6.3% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 14% growth forecast for the Machinery industry in India. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 19% per year whereas the company’s share price has increased by 15% per year.

news.title: Dividend of ₹18.00 announced
news.body: Shareholders will receive a dividend of ₹18.00. Ex-date: 16th February 2026 Payment date: 1st January 1970 Dividend yield will be 1.0%, which is higher than the industry average of 0.6%. Sustainability & Growth Dividend is well covered by both earnings (15% earnings payout ratio) and cash flows (44% cash payout ratio). The dividend has increased by an average of 41% per year over the past 10 years and has been stable with no material reductions to payments, indicating a long track record of dividend growth and stability. EPS is expected to grow by 29% over the next 3 years, which should provide support to the dividend and adequate earnings cover.

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹32.57 (vs ₹26.18 in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹32.57 (up from ₹26.18 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹32.8b (up 11% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹3.58b (up 24% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 11% (up from 9.8% in 3Q 2025). The increase in margin was driven by higher revenue. Revenue is forecast to grow 13% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 13% growth forecast for the Machinery industry in India. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 22% per year and the company’s share price has also increased by 22% per year.

news.title: Escorts Kubota Limited Approves Special Dividend for the Financial Year 2025-26
news.body: Escorts Kubota Limited at its board meeting held on February 10, 2026, approved Special Dividend of INR 18/- (180%) per fully paid-up equity share of INR 10/- each, for the Financial Year 2025-26. The Record Date for the payment of Special Dividend shall be February 16, 2026 and the aforesaid dividend shall be paid within 30 days.
